contradictions.description: Signed Proof of Delivery PDF claims 42.5 kg delivered with INTACT seal in Mumbai on 2026-11-20, contradicting GPS telemetry JSON and Pune weighbridge PNG showing weight dropped to 18.0 kg with TAMPERED/BROKEN seal in Pune on 2026-11-19.

Rohan Kulkarni (EMP-407) claimed flight and hotel expenses in New Delhi on 2026-11-19 in expense_claims.xlsx, while biometric and RFID logs in gate_security_log.txt confirm physical entry/exit at Bengaluru Hub on 2026-11-19 (09:02 to 17:45).

On 2026-11-20, EMP-407 is recorded in three incompatible cities: Bengaluru Hub biometric entry at 08:30 (gate_security_log.txt), on-site delivery sign-off in Mumbai at 14:20 (delivery_receipt_signed.pdf), and a client dinner claim in New Delhi (expense_claims.xlsx).
